candidates.name: Erdheim-Chester disease
support_spans: bilateral symmetric sclerotic changes of the distal femora and proximal tibiae
intramedullary sclerosis of the distal humeri
sclerosis of the proximal ulnae and radii without fracture
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of diffuse bone pain and symmetric sclerotic changes on radiographs is consistent with Erdheim-Chester disease.

candidates.name: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
support_spans: diffuse infiltration by foamy histiocytes and fibrosis with rare Touton-like giant cells
immunohistochemical staining of the histiocytes was positive for CD68, CD163, and factor XIIIa
contradict_spans: no granulomas or malignant cells were identified
candidates.why: The presence of foamy histiocytes and Touton-like giant cells on biopsy is suggestive of Langerhans cell histiocytosis, but the negative staining for CD1a and S100 makes this diagnosis less likely.
